articles.title: New Hampshire National Guard breaks ground on new Plymouth Readiness Center

articles.title: Judges close part of ICC Afghanistan investigations that could look at US troops
articles.summary: The International Criminal Court will close investigations into Afghanistan that previously looked at alleged crimes by U.S. troops and focus only on actions of the Taliban.
